title: Little Otter, Crack, Crack!
alt: A rusty red-brown sea otter floats on a turquoise ripple, holding a lavender clam and waving. A blue-gray stone rests on its tummy.
caption: A little shell. A tasty surprise.

title: Look! A shell. A little shell.
cue: Tap the shell. What did Otter find?
alt: Little Otter scoops a closed lavender clam from the water with one paw.

title: A little stone. On my tummy!
cue: Tap the stone. Where does it go?
action: Place the stone on Otter’s tummy
alt: Little Otter sets an oval blue-gray stone flat on its tummy while holding the closed clam near its chest.
feedback: On my tummy. Ready to tap!

title: Shell up high. Ready, steady...
cue: Tap the shell. Here we go!
action: Get ready to tap the shell
alt: Little Otter holds the closed lavender clam with both paws just above the stone resting on its tummy.

title: Tap, tap. Crack, crack!
cue: Tap the shell to crack it open.
action: Crack the shell against the stone
alt: Little Otter taps a closed clam against the stone on its tummy. A fine crack appears in the shell.
resultAlt: Little Otter holds an open lavender clam with two creamy halves and one peach-colored morsel inside. The stone rests on its tummy.

title: An open shell! A tasty bite inside.
cue: Tap the open shell. What is inside?
action: Discover the food inside the shell
alt: Little Otter holds an open lavender clam with two creamy halves and one peach-colored morsel inside. The stone rests on its tummy.

title: A little bite. Yum, yum!
cue: Tap Little Otter. Say yum, yum!
alt: Little Otter brings one peach-colored morsel to its mouth; the open clam in its other paw is empty.

title: Lick, lick. Clean little paws.
action: Help Little Otter clean its paws
alt: Little Otter licks its two paws under its mouth, floating with an empty tummy and no shell or stone.

title: Full little tummy. Float, float. Time to rest.
cue: Tap the tummy. Take a little rest.
alt: Little Otter floats peacefully on its back with eyes closed and both paws resting on its empty tummy.
